> The issue number is the **task ID** used in branch names, commit scopes
> (`<task>-S<n>`), and the detailed plan. Keep the description as provided —
> the workflow splits and numbers it into subtasks, it does not rewrite it.

<!-- What is to be done, in the user's words. One task = one responsibility. -->

     here must be traceable to committed, checked Rocq. -->
